finalText:
**Found it and fixed it.**

The pricing code was rounding to cents twice: once right after the percent discount, and again after the flat discount — both in dollars, before converting to the shopper's currency. That early rounding threw away tiny fractions that mattered once the exchange rate got applied.

That's why it only showed up sometimes: it needed a percent coupon (SAVE10PCT), a non-USD currency, and a basket total that happened to sit near a rounding edge. Flat-only or no-coupon carts never hit it.

`src/pricing/engine.js` now applies both discounts in full precision and rounds only once, at the very end, in the order's own currency. All 40 tests pass now, versus 10 failing before.
